Educational services

Mathematics tutoring

Tell Mr. Kamulegeya what the student needs. He will confirm what he can offer, and when.

01

One-on-one tutoring

Individual sessions focused on one student’s mathematics. On the booking form, say which topic you need help with and what kind of support you are looking for.

Availability is confirmed on enquiry.Enquire
02

Group tutoring

Sessions for more than one student. Tell us how many students are involved and which topic you want to cover.

Availability is confirmed on enquiry.Enquire
03

Examination preparation

Preparation and revision ahead of mathematics examinations. Mention the examination and the topics that need the most attention.

Availability is confirmed on enquiry.Enquire
04

Online tutoring

Sessions held remotely. Choose “Online” on the booking form and Mr. Kamulegeya will confirm whether it can be arranged.

Availability is confirmed on enquiry.Enquire
05

Mathematics consultation

A conversation about a student’s mathematics needs or a learning plan. Use the message field to describe what you would like to discuss.

Availability is confirmed on enquiry.Enquire

How it works

From enquiry to session.

  1. Send a request

    Complete the booking form with the topic and your preferred time.

  2. Send the summary

    The form prepares a summary for you to send; nothing goes out automatically.

  3. Wait for confirmation

    Mr. Kamulegeya confirms the topic, time and format. Nothing is booked before that.
